purpose: Teach: 吸着/触発/技量/施術/力説/肝炎/訪米/致死

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、現場の物質吸着サンプルを警察、採取されてますね
lines.en: So the police have already collected the material absorption samples from the scene, then?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly deferential. Seeking confirmation with genuine curiosity. Slow, careful pacing—the tone of someone working through technical details. Keeps eye contact but doesn't push.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者を触発する報道を警戒します
lines.en: We're careful to monitor any press coverage that might agitate the suspects.
lines.style: Measured, professional. Even cadence—matter-of-fact but not cold. The practiced clarity of someone who has explained procedure many times. Steady eye contact, no apology in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察の技量に頼っております
lines.en: We're relying on the police's expertise with this case.
lines.style: Genuine respect beneath the surface formality. Quiet sincerity on 「頼って」. No flattery—acknowledgment of competence. Slight lean forward, as if sharing responsibility.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不法施術医療業者を摘発します
lines.en: We're going to crack down on illegal medical practitioners.
lines.style: Firmer resolve here. Slight emphasis on 「摘発」—conviction without aggression. The tone shifts to stated purpose. Shoulders set, voice carries authority but not harshness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、市民安全の重要性を力説されてますね
lines.en: It's clear the police are emphasizing how critical public safety is in this case.
lines.style: Acknowledging, almost nodding through the words. Recognizes a principle being stated. Warm agreement—not challenging, but understanding. Soft landing at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、肝炎キャリア被害者の支援にも対応します
lines.en: We're also taking steps to support victims who are hepatitis carriers.
lines.style: Steady, compassionate beneath the procedure. Widening the scope—showing the full picture of care. Voice opens slightly on 「支援」. Not rehearsed; genuine commitment to the detail.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、訪米中の要人の警備を警察、ご担当ですね
lines.en: So the police are also handling security for the dignitaries visiting from the US?
lines.style: Recognition of scope expanding. Slightly impressed—seeking confirmation of the breadth of responsibility. Measured tone, genuine respect. Pause before 「ご担当」, deferential but not obsequious.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、致死性毒物の流通を厳格に取り締まります
lines.en: We're strictly controlling the distribution of lethal toxins.
lines.style: Final statement—clear, decisive. Firm emphasis on 「厳格に」. This is the bottom line. Voice carries weight without raising volume. Closes the conversation with finality.
